title: MusicDrop v1.4.8 Available
changelog:
• Artist Options Bottom Sheet: Clean, theme-matching action sheet with Play, Play next, Add to queue, Add to playlist, and Edit tags / rename
• Real Artist Cover Art: Integrated Deezer & iTunes artist photo repositories displaying genuine high-res covers and logos (e.g. T-Series, Sony, regional artists)
• Themed Brand Header & Profile: Dynamic accent-primary branding and settings button replacing hardcoded static colors
• Shorts Player Autoplay & Controls: Instant muted autoplay with smooth audio unmute, plus dedicated Play/Pause toggle and touch controls
